changes_made.explanation: Added all baseline models explicitly evaluated in the paper. Removed MentalBART and MentalT5 which were only mentioned in literature review but not evaluated. Normalized model names to include version numbers. Added 'Clinical note generation' as an additional output type based on ACI-BENCH experiments.
Normalized all ROUGE variants to 'ROUGE' and BLEURT variations to 'BLEURT' according to simplification rules. MHIC was kept as a distinct metric since it's domain-specific.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses automatic metrics and human/expert evaluation, but no LLM-based assessment of generated outputs.

changes_made.explanation: Added the clinical acceptability framework criteria used in expert evaluation. Normalized 'opportunity costs' to 'opportunity cost'. Included both human evaluation criteria (linguistic experts) and clinical expert evaluation criteria.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on counseling summarization using a novel planning engine (PIECE) integrated with LLMs. Evaluation includes automatic metrics (ROUGE, BLEURT, MHIC), human evaluation by linguistic experts, and expert evaluation by clinical psychologists. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some baseline models and the clinical evaluation criteria. The paper does not use LLM-as-judge evaluation.
